meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude 会变成编排者,不亲自干活,而是派发子代理分阶段执行实施计划;每个阶段部署子代理做验证、反模式检查和代码质量审查,验证通过后才提交。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落地一份实施计划时触发,尤其是 make-plan 生成的那类计划。

say.text: 按这份计划开始执行第一阶段
say.note: 会派子代理实现,完成后跑验证清单

say.text: 执行这份 make-plan 生成的计划,每验证一阶段就提交
say.note: 阶段之间会同步到工作分支

say.text: 帮我验证上一阶段的改动,不通过就不要提交
say.note: 派验证子代理核对清单后再决定

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: it deploys subagents to execute a phased plan instead of doing the work. Each phase runs implementation, then verification, anti-pattern and code-quality checks; commit only after verification passes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Start executing phase one of this plan
Execute this make-plan plan and commit after each verified phase
say_en.note: Syncs to the working branch between phases

say_en.text: Verify the last phase's changes; don't commit if it fails
say_en.note: Runs the checklist before allowing a commit
